title: SeaYa Fishing
specs: Fishing in Florida Keys and Everglades for species including tarpon, bonefish, permit, redfish, snook, snapper, grouper, sailfish, mahi, tuna

includes: All fishing gear including rods, reels, bait

blurb: Guests fish for species like bonefish, tarpon, permit, snapper, grouper, sailfish, mahi, and tuna in the Florida Keys and Everglades. Trips are tailored to skill level from novice to experienced anglers. Captain Brian Helms provides all gear except for personal items like lunch and sunscreen.
extraNote: $200 per day deposit required to hold booking · Deposit minus credit card fees refunded if cancelled more than 30 days before trip · Deposit refunded if weather is unsafe as determined by captain
